picks.file: View of Durrës from the Adriatic Sea (postcard)(AK092 074).jpg
picks.what: View from the sea, postcard (Austrian National Library)
picks.why: color general view of the town on its hill from the sea; trim drops the card edge and caption

picks.what: Panorama from the castle tower, photograph
picks.why: recent color view over the center to the sea, with the domed mosque and towers

gaps: P0–P4: no candidates. P5 has four candidates but only one may be used.
notes: P5 alternatives: #2 (Haeckel, 1910s, sharp B&W view over the walled old town toward the harbor) is the best black-and-white option; #3 (1916, from the sea) and #1 (Hasluck 1928, mostly the plain and lagoon) are weaker. The postcard’s 1914 date may be its posting date, hence “about 1914”.
